clinical_characteristics.value: The FTD cohort comprised behavioural-variant FTD, semantic dementia, and progressive nonfluent aphasia. Groups were matched for sex, age, and education; disease duration differed across patient groups, with semantic dementia having longer disease duration than progressive nonfluent aphasia. All participants underwent clinical, neuropsychological, and structural MRI assessment.
